title: Motu Patlu Kung Fu Kings Returns
original_title: Motu Patlu Kung Fu Kings Returns
overview: When Tim Tim, the grandson of Motu’s Kung Fu mentor, Himnaresh, is abducted by a mysterious creature, Motu Patlu are assigned the task of rescuing Tim Tim. Join Motu Patlu on their journey high up into the spooky valleys of the mysterious Snake Mountain, to fight an army raised by an evil scientist.
